honesty.sameness_not_correctness: determinism proves the answer is the SAME, not that it is RIGHT — a deterministically wrong answer is still wrong; the clinical gate remains writegate plus a named human reviewer
honesty.proven_not_asserted: this platform does not claim a mathematical framework that eliminates drift by construction; it proves bitwise equality per run and names the layer that moved when equality breaks
honesty.executor_seam: the demo's model is a pure function; production injects an external runtime through the same seam — no runtime is ever embedded (ADR-0005)
